title: Fine-Tune UI Text: Master CSS 'letter-spacing' for Optimal Readability & Design
tweet: Boost your UI's visual harmony! Learn how CSS 'letter-spacing' refines text readability and elevates your web typography. Essential for #CSSTypography #WebDesign #UIUX
tip: Subtle adjustments to 'letter-spacing' (tracking) can dramatically improve the legibility and aesthetic balance of both headlines and body text. Generally, decrease spacing slightly for larger, display fonts and increase it for smaller, all-caps text to enhance user experience and visual comfort. Always test across different font sizes, weights, and devices to find the perfect harmony.
